CMD: 0x3A (COLMOD) — Interface Pixel Format

```
SWRESET (0x01)          -- Software Reset, 150ms delay
SLPOUT  (0x11)          -- Sleep Out, 120ms delay
COLMOD  (0x3A)  0x55    -- 16-bit/pixel (RGB565)
MADCTL  (0x36)  0x00    -- Normal orientation (or 0x08 for BGR)
PORCTRL (0xB2)  0x0C, 0x0C, 0x00, 0x33, 0x33  -- Porch control
GCTRL   (0xB7)  0x35    -- Gate control: VGH=13.26V, VGL=-10.43V
VCOMS   (0xBB)  0x19    -- VCOM=0.725V
LCMCTRL (0xC0)  0x2C    -- LCM control
VDVVRHEN(0xC2)  0x01    -- VDV and VRH from CMD enable
VRHS    (0xC3)  0x12    -- VRH=4.45+( vcom+vcom offset+vdv )
VDVSET  (0xC4)  0x20    -- VDV=0V
FRCTR2  (0xC6)  0x0F    -- Frame rate=60Hz
PWCTRL1 (0xD0)  0xA4, 0xA1  -- AVDD=6.8V, AVCL=-4.8V, VDDS=2.3V
PVGAMCTRL(0xE0) 0xD0, 0x04, 0x0D, 0x11, 0x13, 0x2B, 0x3F, 0x54, 0x4C, 0x18, 0x0D, 0x0B, 0x1F, 0x23  -- Positive gamma
NVGAMCTRL(0xE1) 0xD0, 0x04, 0x0C, 0x11, 0x13, 0x2C, 0x3F, 0x44, 0x51, 0x2F, 0x1F, 0x1F, 0x20, 0x23  -- Negative gamma
INVON    (0x21)          -- Inversion On (some panels need INVON, others INVOFF)

This means it relies entirely on the ST7789's power-on-reset default values for those parameters, which may cause suboptimal display quality (incorrect gamma, wrong VCOM, etc.) compared to the ESP-IDF reference implementation.
